content.text: Explain the login flow with a sequence diagram and the states

Here is the login flow:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant A as App
    participant S as Auth server
    U->>A: open app
    A->>S: authorize (PKCE)
    S-->>U: login page
    U->>S: credentials
    S-->>A: code
    A->>S: token request
    S-->>A: access + refresh token
```

And the session states:

```plantuml
@startuml
[*] --> LoggedOut
LoggedOut --> Authorizing : login
Authorizing --> LoggedIn : token
LoggedIn --> Refreshing : expired
Refreshing --> LoggedIn : ok
Refreshing --> LoggedOut : refresh failed
LoggedIn --> LoggedOut : logout
@enduml
```
